name: HAZY PALE
facts: 40% FEWER CALS THAN NORMAL PALE ALES
Lowrise Hazy Pale bursts with stone fruit and citrus flavours, before easing into a smooth, delicious finish.
Brewed with sun-kissed New Zealand hops and British pale malts, it’s low cal without compromise.
INGREDIENTS: WATER, MALTED BARLEY, HOPS AND YEAST.
The UK Chief Medical Officers recommend that adults do not regularly drink more than 14 units per week.
